jobs.title: Quality Assurance Consultant
jobs.description:
**Position Overview :**
  
Our client in San Jose, CA, is seeking a Quality Assurance Consultant for a three-month engagement to support manufacturing compliance initiatives and remediation activities in preparation for an anticipated FDA inspection in early 2027.

The consultant will focus on addressing manufacturing deviations, CAPAs, and quality findings identified through internal facility and manufacturing line audits. Responsibilities may also include reviewing GMP batch records, evaluating documentation for compliance, and supporting efforts to ensure manufacturing operations are inspection-ready as the company advances toward a Biologics License Application (BLA).

The ideal candidate brings experience in pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical manufacturing quality, deviation investigations, CAPA management.  
**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Review and address manufacturing deviations and CAPAs identified through internal audits of the facility and manufacturing operations.
* Support root cause investigations, develop corrective and preventive action plans, and assist with timely resolution of outstanding quality issues.
* Evaluate manufacturing processes and documentation to identify compliance gaps and opportunities for remediation.
* Review GMP batch production records for completeness, accuracy, adherence to procedures, and compliance with applicable quality requirements.
* Support the development, execution, and documentation of corrective actions to strengthen compliance.
* Partner with Quality Assurance, Manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams to resolve quality issues and ensure effective implementation of remediation activities.
* Maintain accurate, complete, and inspection-ready documentation of investigations, CAPAs, and related quality activities.
* Support inspection-readiness initiatives in anticipation of an FDA inspection expected between February and April 2027.
* Contribute to quality and compliance activities supporting the company's progress toward a BLA submission.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Compliance, or Manufacturing Quality within the pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical industry.
* Hands-on experience investigating manufacturing deviations and managing CAPAs in a GMP-regulated environment.
* Experience reviewing batch records and manufacturing documentation.
* Strong investigation, documentation, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize remediation activities, and deliver results within a defined contract period.

jobs.title: Partner Enablement Lead, Beneficial Deployments
jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

Anthropic's Beneficial Deployments team brings Claude to organizations doing some of the world's most important work across the nonprofit and education sectors. These organizations share a problem: mission-critical work, thin budgets, and little slack to figure out new technology on their own. Our Customer Success team helps them go from first login to Claude being part of how their teams work, but we cannot do that one organization at a time, nor should we. The sector already has trusted intermediaries these organizations turn to first: networks, capacity builders, funder technical assistance providers, community colleges, and fellowship programs. This role exists to make those intermediaries as effective at activating and training organizations on Claude as our own Customer Success team is.

As the Scaled Enablement Lead, you'll build the Claude for Nonprofits train-the-trainer program that qualifies intermediaries to onboard organizations and deliver Anthropic-designed workshops on our behalf. You'll own the kits, credentials, and quality gates that let them run the show without an Anthropic CSM in the room. You'll also own the enablement thinking behind scaling impact through Claude Corps: how what fellows learn and build serves every organization we support, not only the ones that host them.

The people you enable are not selling Claude. They are trainers, implementers, and program staff whose job is to help mission-driven organizations meaningfully adopt AI. Your job is to make sure these intermediaries can do that with Claude, to the same bar we hold ourselves to, and to help them evolve their offerings as we learn what these organizations need. The measure of success for this role is organizations activated and trained well without Anthropic delivering it.

You'll be half program builder, half facilitator. You'll design and deliver the first cohorts yourself, then make the system repeatable: kits, qualification paths, credentials, teach-back gates, and a refresh rhythm that keeps content current as our products change. You'll build on the operating model and certification infrastructure of Anthropic's Education team and own everything specific to this audience, working closely with Beneficial Deployments Customer Success, Partnerships, Claude Corps program leadership, and our Education teams.

This is not a partner account management or alliances role, and it carries no quota. It is not a book-of-business Customer Success role either, though you'll spend time with organizations to stay grounded in what these nonprofits truly need. The role reports to the Customer Success Lead for Beneficial Deployments, has no direct reports today, and may grow into people management as the program scales. Expect periodic travel for in-person cohorts and sessions.

**Key responsibilities:**
-------------------------

* Own the Claude for Nonprofits train-the-trainer program end to end: its tracks, the qualification path for each, the credential, and recertification
* Build the kits intermediaries teach from: an activation playbook covering kickoff, admin setup, launch, and Day 30/60/90 reviews, and workshop-in-a-box modules starting with AI fluency and use case discovery, each with a deck, facilitator guide, demo scripts, sample data, and workbook
* Recruit and qualify a pilot cohort of anchor intermediaries, then open a repeatable application process that routes each to the right track and the right home, whether the Claude Partner Network or a Beneficial Deployments credential
* Design and deliver enablement for network intermediaries, adapting the program to how each reaches and supports its members, and help them evolve their offerings as we learn what organizations need
* Build the connective tissue among intermediaries so they learn from each other: shared office hours, a facilitator cohort that stays together after qualification, and a clear path for bringing new intermediaries along
* Support the enablement thinking for Claude Corps: how we extend the reach of fellows and the organizations around the program, and how what they learn feeds back into the enablement every customer receives
* Hold the quality bar when Anthropic is not in the room through teach-back gates, graded mock sessions, shadowing, and session satisfaction and activation quality at or above Anthropic-led benchmarks
* Run the program as one system: content intake and refresh calendar, production standards, resource hub organization, learning management system courses and assessments, and the agreement and attribution model for intermediaries acting on Anthropic's behalf
* Own the program's numbers, including approved trainers, collaborator-led activations and workshops, the Anthropic effort required per organization activated, and quality against benchmark, and use them to decide where the effort goes next
* Be the field voice for intermediaries inside Anthropic, bringing what they learn back into our enablement content, product feedback, and engagement model

**Minimum qualifications:**
---------------------------

* **7+ years of experience** in enablement, training, or program management
* **Train-the-trainer at scale.** You have built and run a program that qualified other people to deliver your training consistently without you in the room: a certified facilitator network, a partner or community education program, or an instructor credential.
* **Learning design and delivery.** You have designed adult learning experiences end to end, including curriculum, facilitator guides, and assessments, and delivered them live

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

Endex builds AI agents that handle complex, end-to-end work for the world's most demanding teams. Today we're deployed across leading financial institutions and Fortune 500 companies, embedded in the tools and workflows they rely on. We operate at the frontier of agentic knowledge work, partnering closely with top AI research labs and backed by the OpenAI Startup Fund. We're on a mission to build the most capable digital coworker in the world.

**About the Role**

**Location:** New York City, San Francisco, Los Angeles, London  
**Commitment:** 5 Days In-Person

We're looking for someone who makes customers successful, not just satisfied. Our customers run agents on real work, where the output has to be right the first time.

As a Customer Success Manager at Endex, you'll own deployment, onboarding, adoption and renewal across our accounts. You'll work directly with our founders, AEs and product team to shape how customers succeed and what we build next.

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* **Own Customer Outcomes:** Be the primary point of contact for a portfolio of accounts from signature through renewal. Know their goals, their teams and exactly where Endex fits in their work.
* **Lead Deployments:** Get new customers live fast. Run kickoffs, configure integrations and partner with IT and InfoSec to clear the path to production.
* **Train and Enable Users:** Run onboarding sessions and workshops that show teams what agents can do across email, Teams, Excel, Word and PowerPoint. Make every user productive in their first week.
* **Drive Adoption:** Monitor usage, find the teams getting the most value and replicate it across the firm. Turn a single team's pilot into firmwide deployment.
* **Protect and Expand Accounts:** Spot risk early and fix it before it becomes churn. Surface expansion opportunities and partner with AEs on renewals and upsells.
* **Be the Voice of the Customer:** You'll hear every request, edge case and frustration first. Translate that into product feedback, bug reports and roadmap input that keeps us ahead.
* **Build the Function:** Create the onboarding playbooks, health metrics and support processes we'll scale on. You're not just running customer success. You're helping define it.

**What We're Looking For**

* **Proven customer leader:** 2+ years in customer success, account management, implementation or consulting. You've owned enterprise accounts and grown them.
* **Customer-obsessed:** You care whether the people you work with actually succeed. You follow up, follow through and make yourself the person customers call first.
* **Technically fluent:** You learn new software quickly and can explain it to anyone. You're comfortable working through integrations, security questions and edge cases with engineers.
* **Credible with experts:** You can hold your own with analysts, operators and executives. You learn a domain fast and speak its language.
* **Commercially minded:** You see renewals and expansion as part of the job. You know how to turn a happy customer into a bigger one.
* **Relentlessly resourceful:** You move fast, leverage your network and figure things out without a playbook.

**Nice to Have**

* Early-stage startup experience
* Experience deploying AI, developer tools or enterprise software

**Full-Time Benefits**

* Health & Dental Insurance
* Monthly Wellness Stipend
* 401K Matching
* Competitive Salary + Equity

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Why Mintlify?**
=================

We're on a mission to empower builders.

* **Massive reach:** Our docs platform serves 100 million+ developers every year and powers documentation for 20,000+ companies, including Anthropic, Microsoft, PayPal, Spotify, Coinbase, X, and over 20% of the last YC batch.
* **Small team, huge impact:** We recently passed 65 employees and raised a $45 million Series B led by A16Z and Salesforce Ventures. Each new hire has a huge impact on shaping the company's trajectory.
* **Culture of** **slope over y-intercept****:** We value learning velocity, grit, and unapologetically unique personalities.

We grew in value faster than headcount and we’re looking to align the two quickly.

**About the role**
==================

We're hiring an Account Manager to grow Mintlify's relationships with a book of customers, each typically $50K–$250K in annual recurring revenue. You'll own the commercial side of these accounts: renewals, expansion, and pricing conversations. Customer Success owns adoption and the day-to-day relationship, and you'll work as one team with them.

Your job is to find where Mintlify can do more for each customer, such as another product team's docs, a help center, or growing AI usage, and turn it into growth. Our buyers are engineering, developer experience, and documentation leaders, so you'll need to be comfortable talking about how docs are built and shipped, even if you don't write code.

* **Team:** Account Management, working alongside Customer Success and our other Account Managers
* **Reports to:** Ben Terrill, Head of Customer Success
* **Location:** San Francisco, in office when you're not traveling
* **Travel:** About one trip per month for customer visits, business reviews, and events
* **Type:** Full-time, quota-carrying

**What you'll do**
==================

**Own and grow your book**
--------------------------

* Manage a book of accounts, each typically $50K–$250K ARR.
* In partnership with a CSM, build an account plan for each: stakeholders, contract terms, usage, and where we can grow.
* Support renewals end to end: forecast early, negotiate terms, and propose multi-year agreements where they fit.

**Find and close expansion with Customer Success**
--------------------------------------------------

* Partner with your CSMs to turn customer signals, such as new teams, new products, or rising AI usage, into qualified opportunities.
* Run discovery, build the business case, then negotiate and close: new sites for other products or business units, help centers and knowledge bases, AI credits, and add-ons.
* Right-size offers: sell the capability a customer needs instead of defaulting to the full bundle.

**Show up in person and go beyond your champion**
-------------------------------------------------

* Spend about one week a month with customers: on-site visits, executive business reviews, and industry events.
* Build relationships across engineering, developer experience, docs, and procurement, not just with your champion.

**Run a clean commercial process**
----------------------------------

* Keep Salesforce current: opportunities, stages, next steps, contacts, and renewal dates.
* Forecast renewals and expansion accurately 30, 60, and 90 days out.
* Bring customer feedback on pricing, packaging, and product gaps back to Product and leadership.
* Share what works with the Account Management team so the best plays become repeatable.

**What we're looking for**
==========================

* 3+ years in a quota-carrying account management role, or an AE role with expansion ownership, at a B2B SaaS company.
* A track record of growing mid-market or enterprise accounts ($50K+ ARR), with expansion numbers you can name.
* Moderate technical understanding: you can explain how a team writes, reviews, and publishes docs (Git, Markdown, APIs, CI/CD), hold your own with engineering leaders, and know when to bring in a Solutions Engineer.
* Strong discovery and negotiation skills, including renewals, multi-year terms, and working with procurement.
* Experience partnering with Customer Success, with clear ownership of the commercial relationship.
* Organized and data-driven: disciplined in Salesforce, accurate in forecasting, and able to read usage data to time an expansion.
* Willing to travel about one week a month.
* Able to work from our San Francisco office when you're not traveling.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* You've sold developer tools, API platforms, or other products bought by engineering teams.
* Experience with usage-based pricing, such as credits or overages.
* You've used Mintlify or another docs platform.
* Familiarity with AI products (AI search, assistants, MCP) and how teams adopt them.
* Early-stage startup experience, especially helping build an account management or expansion motion.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

* **30 days:** You know your book (every account's contract, renewal date, usage, and key contacts), you've met your CSM partners and top customers, and you have a plan for each account.
* **90 days:** Every renewal in the next two quarters has a plan and a next step, you've made your first on-site visits, and your qualified expansion pipeline is growing.
* **6 months:** You're closing expansion every month, renewals land on time without surprises, and your forecast is reliable.
* **12 months:** You've hit your expansion number, your book grows net revenue year over year, and at least one play you built is used across the team.

**Company Benefits:**
=====================

* Competitive compensation and equity
* 20 days paid time off every year
* 401k with Employer Match
* monthly wellness stipend
* 100% employee coverage for Health, Dental, Vision
* Commute stipend to help get you to and from work
* Free lunch and dinners
* Annual team offsite (previously went to Alaska, Hawaii, Jackson Hole)

Compensation Range: $150K - $250K

jobs.title: Customer Account Manager - Strategic - West
jobs.description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world's most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what's next.  
  
Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next-generation skills.  
  
People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.

#### **About the role**

We're hiring an Enterprise Customer Account Manager who will own relationships with some of our most strategic customers. You'll guide them through every stage of their journey – from adoption to expansion - driving measurable business impact and long-term success. This role blends strategy, execution, and relationship depth: you'll act as the captain for your accounts, orchestrating internal and customer teams, solving challenges, and ensuring every customer achieves tangible outcomes with HackerRank.

We're seeking candidates based in a major metro area with convenient access to a major airport. Preferred locations include the **San Francisco Bay Area, New York City, Los Angeles, and Seattle**.

Candidates based in the **San Francisco Bay Area or New York City are required to follow a hybrid schedule**. Candidates based in Los Angeles or Seattle may work remotely.

#### **What you'll do**

* Maintain full functional and process knowledge of HackerRank products and services as well as market awareness and knowledge of competitive threats.
* Own and manage your Book of Business (BoB) - driving adoption, retention, and expansion across enterprise customers through deep partnership and measurable outcomes.
* Develop and execute account strategies that connect customer objectives with HackerRank's mission, ensuring long-term value realization and growth.
* Build trusted relationships with executive sponsors and technical leaders, embedding HackerRank into their hiring and workforce planning.
* Act as the captain for your accounts – leading internal and customer teams, resolving blockers, and accelerating time-to-value.
* Run proactive engagement cadences including QBRs, success check-ins, and executive reviews.
* Structure mutually beneficial commercial terms that promote long-term growth and customer success, balancing value realization with business expansion.
* Maintain accurate forecasts, health metrics, and growth pipelines while ensuring seamless handoffs and transparent reporting.

#### **Who you are**

* Bring 5+ years of Saas enterprise account management, ideally in fast-scaling environments.
* Known for your grit and curiosity, you stay resilient through challenges while constantly seeking to understand your customers' goals, industry shifts, and opportunities to create value.
* Naturally relationship-oriented, you build trust and credibility with Fortune 500 customers, becoming a long-term advisor who drives both strategic and measurable outcomes.
* A strong communicator and collaborator, you simplify complex ideas, engage confidently across audiences, and bring your customer and internal teams together around shared goals.
* Deeply expert in your craft, you combine product mastery with a keen sense of business impact, connecting HackerRank's platform to customer value.
* Highly organized and outcome-driven, you manage multiple enterprise accounts with precision – balancing structure, transparency, and consistent delivery.

#### **Even better if you have**

* Experience working with HR tech or developer ecosystems, especially within enterprise-scale organizations.
* A background in driving multi-product adoption or leading high-growth, customer-centric initiatives.
* Comfort navigating cross-functional complexity to align internal teams and deliver unified customer outcomes.

#### **You will thrive in this role if**

* You act like a captain, owning outcomes end-to-end and thriving in fast-moving, high-accountability environments.
* Building long-term partnerships energizes you more than short-term wins.
* You balance empathy with execution - understanding customer pain points while driving tangible business results.

This sales role is eligible for incentive-based pay, with an annual total potential earnings range of $200,000 to $250,000, including base salary and incentive-based compensation (based on quota attainment).

jobs.title: Global Account Manager - Consulting & Research Agencies
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews.

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures.

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people.

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

We’re hiring a **Global Account Manager, Consulting & Research Agencies** to own and aggressively grow Outset’s relationships with the world’s leading **management consulting and professional services firms**.

A global consulting firm is not one customer; it’s hundreds. Strategy, customer and CX, digital and product, marketing, private equity and due diligence practices each run research for their clients—across dozens of countries, with partner-level budget owners and engagement-by-engagement buying. Firms also increasingly want to deliver AI-powered research as part of their own client offerings. That makes consulting both one of our biggest direct markets and a powerful route to the world’s largest enterprises.

This is a **senior individual contributor role reporting to the VP of Sales**. You’ll carry **full commercial ownership of a small number of global firms**—expansion, cross-sell, pricing, and renewal—and an aggressive seven-figure growth target against them. You’ll go deep in a handful of firms, build relationships from engagement managers to practice leaders to firm leadership, and turn project-by-project usage into firm-wide agreements.

You’ll do it with an account team around you—Sales Development, Research Operations, an Account Director, and a Solutions Consultant, with executive sponsorship from our leadership team—and in close partnership with our Partnerships team where firms bring Outset to their clients.

**Responsibilities**

* Own a portfolio of a small number of **global consulting and professional services firms**, with full commercial responsibility for expansion, cross-sell, pricing, and renewal.
* Carry and exceed an **aggressive seven-figure growth target** across that portfolio.
* Build and maintain a live global account plan for each firm: every practice, industry group, region, and research function; partner-level relationships; whitespace and spend; competitive position; and a dated path to each expansion.
* Convert **engagement-by-engagement usage into firm-wide and multi-year agreements**, including enterprise licenses, preferred-vendor status, and global MSAs.
* Multi-thread relentlessly—from consultants and engagement managers to partners, practice leaders, and firm leadership—building relationships durable enough to survive partner turnover and reorgs.
* Direct the extended account team (Sales Development, Research Operations, Account Director, Solutions Consultant, Marketing, and executive sponsors) across functions and time zones.
* Run executive business reviews that tie Outset to firm outcomes—faster engagements, higher-margin delivery, and differentiated client offerings—and convert them into committed budget.
* Negotiate and close complex agreements—global MSAs, multi-region commitments, procurement, security, and client-data confidentiality reviews—in partnership with Legal, Finance, and leadership.
* Forecast with precision and keep a clean, current view of your accounts in Salesforce.
* Bring the voice of consulting firms back into Outset—informing product direction, pricing, and how we build the global account motion.
* Regularly meet in person with partner leads across practices to create deep relationships with those driving business performance and who are responsible for partner-level results delivery, as well as operational leaders in centralized roles.

**Qualifications**

* **10+ years in enterprise sales**, including **5+ years in a named global or strategic account role** owning a small book of major accounts.
* **Demonstrated experience and expertise selling into and growing accounts at global consulting, market research and professional services firms**—strategy firms, the Big Three, the largest global market research agencies or large digital and technology consultancies.
* Deep understanding of how consulting firms buy: **partner-led decisions, practice and regional budgets, engagement-funded spend**, and central procurement.
* A proven record of exceeding aggressive seven-figure growth targets *inside existing accounts*—expansion, cross-sell, and renewal—not only net-new logo attainment.
* World-class relationship management, with accounts you grew over years, not quarters.
* Executive presence and commercial sharpness: credible with partners and firm leadership, and comfortable negotiating at scale.
* Demonstrated ability to lead an extended, cross-functional account team without direct authority.
* Experience with complex global commercial structures: multi-region contracting, enterprise procurement, multi-year commitments, and competing internal stakeholders.
* Operational rigor—a real account planning methodology, accurate forecasting, and CRM discipline.
* Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced startup that is still building the playbook.
* Travel regularly to customer sites will be necessary to achieve your goals, and should be part of your prior playbook. Travel to our San Francisco HQ will also be required periodically.
* Bonus: prior consulting experience, or experience selling research, insights,

jobs.title: CalAIM ECM Care Manager (JR 5881)
jobs.description:
**WHY WORK FOR US?**  
We are mission and values driven and your contributions will make a difference. We make a positive difference in people's lives and help an average of 23 people per week to find a place to live.

If you join us, you will be able to advocate for change while also working with influential people who effect changes in policy and devote time to issues of racial and social justice. We prioritize your work/life balance and provide various scheduling options in addition to generous time off, health, and wellness benefits and we're committed to helping you reach your potential by providing opportunities for professional growth across the state.

**JR 5881**  
**CalAIM ECM Case Manager**  
**San Jose, CA**  
**Salary: $28.58 - $34.84** per hour  
**Pay Frequency:** 24 Pay Periods Per Year  
**Full Time**  
**Non-Exempt**  
**Driving Required**  
Lower end of range will apply to candidates who meet minimum experience or have limited years of relevant experience. The higher end of range will apply to seasoned candidates with considerable years of relevant experience.

-

PATH is seeking candidates passionate about helping others make a positive change in their lives to join our San Jose team as the CalAIM ECM Case Manager at the Evans Lane office.

**ABOUT PATH**  
Since its foundation in 1984, PATH (People Assisting The Homeless) has pioneered bold and effective approaches to assist people experiencing homelessness. PATH operates services throughout California, connecting our clients to a comprehensive continuum of homelessness prevention, street outreach, employment preparation and placement assistance, individualized case management, supportive services, interim housing, and permanent supportive housing.

  

**ABOUT THE JOB**  
This role as Care Manager under CalAIM's Enhanced Care Management program will focus on member medical care coordination, assist in navigation of the health care system, and work with other team members to ensure the medical and housing stability of each participant. Position Responsibilities include:

* Conducts intake and individualized needs assessment for all participants and collaborates to develop Individualized Service Plan (ISP) that addresses housing goals, maintaining/increasing income and other personal goals identified by the participant including medical, mental health,  
  substance use, financial resources, vocational, and social support needs
* Provides referrals, linkages, information, and support to resources that help participants to achieve their ISP goals
* Completes program specific assessments (e.g. VI-SPDAT)
* Evaluates strengths and challenges to addressing short term and long-term goals, conducts a 90-day review with the participant after initial intake
* Maintains documentation standards as required by the Program and PATH policies, including completing case file notes in a timely manner and maintains a complete, accurate, and current participant file with all required documents

**WHAT YOU BRING**  
We're looking for candidates with:

* Analytical Skills and Attention to Detail: Gather and interpret data, identifying trends, patterns, and insights to inform decision-making. Ability to consistently produce high-quality work, ensuring accuracy and precision in all tasks.
* Collaboration and Teamwork: Work effectively with others, seeking out and building positive working relationships with colleagues, participants, and stakeholders. Work effectively with others, contributing to team goals and recognizing the strengths and contributions of others.
* Communication: Convey information clearly and effectively (both verbally and in writing) to individuals and groups in a manner that informs, engages and maintains their attention.
* Creativity and Initiative: Take action and make decisions without being prompted, demonstrating a proactive approach to work and a willingness to take on additional responsibilities. Think outside the box, generating innovative solutions to problems or challenges.
* Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: Analyze and evaluate information and situations, identify key issues, consider alternatives, and make logical decisions based on sound reasoning that will achieve the desired outcome.
* Ethics and Boundaries: Maintain ethical and professional standards, demonstrating honesty, integrity, and a commitment to doing the right thing in all situations while maintaining professional boundaries.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Two (2) years of experience in healthcare, case management, homeless services or working with vulnerable populations or a related field.

  

**MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS**  
Regardless of qualifications, candidates must:

* Have employment eligibility verification
* Have or be able and willing to obtain CPR/First Aid training
* Successfully complete the following as a condition of hire:
  + Tuberculosis Test
  + Background Screening
  + Drug Test

**DRIVING**  
Driving is an **essential function** of this position. To meet the employment requirements for this role, all candidates must:

* Have reliable transportation
* A valid driver's license
* Proof of insurance and ownership for personal vehicles used during work duties
* The ability to qualify for PATH's insurance coverage

**EMPLOYMENT ELIGIBILITY**  
Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa.

PATH is committed to maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and objectivity in our services and employment practices. jobs.title: Recruiter / People Operations
jobs.description:
**LiveX AI · Recruiter / People Operations**  
Palo Alto, CA · Full-time, in-person · Department: People · Reports to: CEO  
Source: https://livex.ai/careers/recruiter-people-operations (posted Oct 6, 2026)

### **About LiveX AI**

LiveX AI builds human-AI interfaces for physical spaces. Its 4K full-body AI agents greet, guide, and sell in retail flagships, hotels, hospitals, airports, convention centers, and stadiums, on-prem or in the cloud, in 140 languages.

### **About the Role**

LiveX is growing across engineering, solutions, go-to-market, and operations, and hiring has outgrown what the founders can handle. This is the company's first dedicated People hire: no HR team, no existing processes. Own full-cycle recruiting for all open roles and the employee experience from offer acceptance through the first 90 days, plus clean exits. Roughly 70% recruiting / 30% onboarding and offboarding. Reports to the CEO, works with every hiring manager; a path to Head of People as the team grows.

### **Responsibilities**

**Recruiting (primary)**

* Run full-cycle recruiting for engineering (AI/ML, full-stack, hardware/edge), solution engineering, sales/GTM, and operations: intake, job posts, sourcing, screening, scheduling, debriefs, offers, closing.
* Proactively build pipeline via sourcing tools, referrals, university/new-grad programs, AI and robotics communities, and events such as NVIDIA GTC; do not wait for inbound.
* Run a fast, candidate-friendly process: structured interviews, scorecards, same-week feedback, weekly pipeline report for the founders.
* Set up and maintain the ATS and key hiring metrics: time-to-fill, pass-through rates, offer-accept rate, cost per hire.
* Manage agency and contract recruiters when used: negotiate terms, enforce quality, control spend.
* Work with founders on offers: leveling, base pay, commission and equity framing, closing candidates with competing offers.

**Onboarding & Offboarding**

* Own signed offer through day 90: offer letters, background checks, I-9 and E-Verify, new-hire paperwork, equipment/account setup with engineering, first-week schedules, 30/60/90-day check-ins.
* Keep the onboarding guide current; every new hire correctly set up in payroll, benefits, and the cap table on day one.
* Coordinate visa-related onboarding (H-1B, OPT/STEM OPT, TN) with outside immigration counsel: document collection, timelines, employee communication.
* Run offboarding: exit checklists, equipment/access recovery, final pay timing under California rules, exit interviews, documentation.
* Maintain accurate, compliant personnel files; point of contact for paperwork, benefits enrollment, and policy questions.

### **Requirements**

* 3–6 years of full-cycle recruiting, including in-house at an early-stage startup (seed to Series B, under ~50 employees).
* Experience hiring both software engineers and salespeople.
* Hands-on onboarding and offboarding end to end, including I-9 and new-hire compliance for California employees.
* Strong sourcing skills; comfortable cold-reaching senior ML engineers or enterprise AEs.
* Organized and systems-minded: builds processes, keeps ATS and personnel records clean without prompting.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; often the first impression of LiveX for candidates.
* Discretion with compensation, equity, immigration, and personnel matters.
* Early-stage operator mindset; comfortable with no existing HR function.
* Able to work on-site in Palo Alto.

### **Nice-to-Haves**

* Recruiting for AI/ML, robotics, computer vision, or hardware roles.
* Hands-on with a modern ATS, HRIS/payroll platform, and cap-table software.
* Experience working with immigration counsel on employment visa cases.

### **Compensation**

Base salary $110,000 – $150,000 per year, plus equity and benefits; placement depends on experience and skills.

### **How to Apply (original posting)**

Send a resume and a short note describing the hardest role you have closed to career@livex.ai, subject "Candidate Application - Recruiter / People Operations".

**About the role**
------------------

We are a small team working on non-invasive brain-computer interfaces, starting with a headset that helps turn thought into text. It's early, hard research, and we're working on it together in San Francisco.

That work happens in our San Francisco office: research, engineering, and the data collection sessions that train our models. We're hiring our first Office Manager to run it, full-time and in person.

**Why this role matters to us**
-------------------------------

We're a team that takes pride in operational excellence. When the office runs well, researchers stay focused, participants have a great experience, and new teammates are productive on day one. When it doesn't, everything slows down.

This role is what keeps it running well. We treat it as core to the company, and you'll work directly with the founding team.

At its heart, this role is about care. You'll get to know the people here, notice what they need, and look after the space as if it were your own. If making a place feel welcoming and well run is something you take pride in, we'd love to meet you.

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Run the office**

* Keep food, snacks, and supplies stocked, and set up a simple way for people to request things.
* Manage cleaning, vendors, inventory, and device tracking.
* Own upkeep of the space: furniture, internet, utilities, keys and building access, air and temperature.
* Greet guests, candidates, and research participants, and set up a guest-access system for the office.

### **Take care of the team**

* Make each teammate's day-to-day setup smooth, from a new hire's first morning to small preferences.
* Notice what's broken or unsystematized and fix it.

### **Run company operations**

* Run payroll and similar important administrative work.
* Coordinate the hiring process: schedule interviews, host candidates on site, and keep them updated.
* Plan team events and offsites.
* Help make our data collection sessions a delightful experience for the participants who come in.

**Who you are**
---------------

* Proactive. You notice things before they become problems, and you'd rather fix something than report it.
* Warm and caring. People are glad when you walk in, and you treat everyone the same, from visitors to the CEO.
* Proud of your work. You care about the details, including the parts of the job that feel small.
* Organized. You keep many small threads moving without dropping any of them.

jobs.description:

Powered by our advanced AI-driven technology platforms, we deliver seamless, tech-driven support across the entire energy service ecosystem to accelerate impactful change and ensure an unmatched customer experience. Since 1994, Franklin Energy has been a trusted partner in protecting communities and our planet, paving the way for a sustainable future for all. Learn more at www.franklinenergy.com and join us in leading the clean energy revolution.
  
  
POSITION SUMMARY
  
The Operations Manager II is primarily responsible for management of the day to day operation of components of the program portfolio/department under the direction of the program/department Manager. These tasks may include management and reporting of staff and program/department performance, forecasting, reporting tracking and reporting of program/department metrics. The position is also responsible for establishing, execution, and reporting of all proactive quality assurance processes.

* Support delivery of operations team goals towards program and portfolio Key Performance Indicators
* Support and deliver payment reviews, application intake, customer service calls, and operations team scheduling
* Program/Project forecasting, tracking, invoicing, and reporting

* Ensure all documentation on contracts, SOWs, Cost Allocation Agreements, KPIs, etc. are up to date and readily available on SharePoint
* Support the organization of financial, legal, and budget tracking responsibilities in relation to portfolio programs compliance
* Manage and track the compliance requirements for contracts, addendums, proposals, and subcontracts for the portfolio
* Complete special ad-hoc projects and reporting for program, program manager, operations manager, and regional director
* Act as a technical resource/consultant to develop systems, processes, and process improvements for the portfolio
* Manage operations team staffing, budgets, goals, productivity, and provide analysis, solutions and recommendations on the operations team to Operations Manager and Regional Director
* Coordinate the internal support team efforts across the portfolio including reporting, meetings, leadership team coordination, and portfolio wide training and events
* Coordinate portfolio resource sharing inside and outside of the portfolio
* Work with internal customers to support the reporting needs of the portfolio, program, and business

Education and Experience
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering or related field from an accredited college or university.
* Previous operations experience including thorough understanding of energy efficiency or demand response program operations and processes
* 3+ years of progressive team management experience including managing and directing the work of direct reports and teams (preferred)

Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities
  
  

* Ability to maintain confidentiality
* Ability to analyze financial data and prepare financial reports and statements
* Ability to analyze program performance data and reports
* Proficient in data analysis and programmatic database management, ticketing, reporting, and dashboards
* Data entry skills in entering, tracking, maintaining, and querying databases
* Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing.
* Ability to communicate to customers, clients, employees, and supervisor effectively

* Ability to add, subtract, multiply and divide. Knowledge of mathematical concepts such as fractions, percentages, and ratios

jobs.title: Clinical Operations Manager
jobs.description:
### **About Aegis Ventures**

**Aegis Ventures** is a next-generation startup studio that partners with entrepreneurs and industry leaders to originate, launch, and scale transformative companies, with a focus on artificial intelligence. The Aegis platform brings together market-shaping ideas, permanent growth capital, and ambitious individuals who are driven to solve major societal problems. Our companies use technology to transform healthcare by dramatically improving quality, access, and cost. Aegis creates new companies with substantial input from our Digital Consortium of a dozen leading health systems and other ecosystem partners. We have launched 6 innovative companies to date and are just getting started.

### **About the Company**

**Optain** is a revolutionary healthcare company that uses groundbreaking software and hardware technology to rethink care. We use the eye as a window to the body to improve the way we detect and manage eye and systemic conditions. Optain is committed to expanding and improving care through the introduction of AI and machine learning technology frontline care settings at an accessible price. This not only promotes greater access to care, but promises to reduce the strains of overburdened healthcare systems.

Originally founded in Australia in 2019, Optain seeks to commercialize the inventions of Professor Mingguang He, a preeminent clinician-scientist and scholar in the field of ophthalmology. Optain has achieved regulatory approval and commercial adoption of its product suite in global markets, including Australia, Europe, and more.

In 2025, Optain received US FDA clearance for its Resolve retinal camera. Optain also recently closed a Series A funding round led by Insight Partners with participation from seven leading U.S. health system investors, including Memorial Hermann Health System, Northwell Health, Novant Health, The Ohio State University Wexner Medical Center, and UPMC. These systems collectively deliver care to 28 million patients across 25 states and have begun deploying Optain's platform across their networks, rapidly accelerating the company's footprint and expanding screening access nationwide. Optain also acquired EyePACS, a teleophthalmology platform with a 15-year history and an established network of licensed optometrists and ophthalmologists who read retinal images for diabetic retinopathy screening.

### **About the Job**

As the **Clinical Operations Manager**, you will own the operations of Optain's provider network - the optometrists and ophthalmologists who read retinal images for health systems, clinics, and community health centers across the United States. The network has run for 15 years on the judgment and relationships of a small number of people. Your job is to turn that into documented policy, a measurable quality program, a capacity model that runs ahead of demand, and a governance rhythm in alignment with Optain’s Medical Director. You will report to the VP of Operations and work day to day with Optain's Medical Director. This is a non-clinical role for someone who has managed a network of contracted clinicians before, writes policy that physicians sign, and knows the difference between running a process and building one that doesn't need you.

Optain is at an inflection point. We have FDA clearance, a growing camera footprint, and a commercial pipeline that is moving fast. Behind every screening exam is a licensed grader reading the images through our EyePACS platform, and the operational infrastructure around that network is being built in real time. This role sits at the center of that work.

This is a remote, US-based position.

### **What You'll Do**

Own the grading playbook, SOPs, onboarding materials, and the provider network policy library

* - author, version, and maintain them, and route clinical content to the Medical Director for review and sign-off.
Establish documentation governance for the network - ownership, versioning, review cadence, and sign-off* - so operating knowledge lives in documents rather than in individuals.
Design and run the grader quality program, including sampling, over-read and discordance review, turnaround accountability, and performance feedback* - establish error rates and trends where today review is periodic and manual.
* Prepare quality reviews and escalations for Medical Director adjudication and carry out the resulting actions, including performance conversations and offboarding.
* Build and maintain a capacity model by state, customer, and license coverage, and set recruitment triggers ahead of turnaround breaches.
* Run the grader recruitment pipeline from sourcing through interview and recommendation, working with the Operations Manager on credentialing and onboarding execution.
Own intake, triage, and routing of customer and grader complaints, including urgent findings workflows* - route clinical questions to the Medical Director, close the loop with the customer, and trend issues over time.
* Set the agenda, prepare decisions, and follow through so the Medical Director's time goes to clinical judgment rather than logistics.
* Partner with Product and Engineering on platform improvements that reduce manual work, including documenting current-state workflows so feature development is accurate and fast, and contribute network measurables to the weekly grader operations rhythm and company scorecard.

### **What You'll Need**

5+ years in healthcare operations, with 2+ years managing a network of contracted or affiliated clinicians

* - telehealth, teleradiology, or virtual care strongly preferred over traditional medical group or IPA settings.
* Has written clinical or operational policy that a physician leader signed, and maintained it afterward.
* Has run or materially contributed to a clinical quality, peer review, or provider performance program.
* Prior experience operating a clinician network under a medical director's clinical oversight is a strong plus.
* Exposur

jobs.description:
**Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.**

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.

  

**Global Contracts Hub Operations Manager (North America)**

This global, North America-based role is responsible for:

* Owning and operating the Contracts Hub as the primary operational owner of its processes, policies, data, metrics, triage and reporting; and
Building a scalable, hands-on contracting operations model across North America, EMEA, APAC and LATAM in partnership with Commercial Legal, Legal Operations and business stakeholders.  

**Contracts Hub Operations & Service Delivery**

* Owns the Contracts Hub as its primary operational owner, including Hub processes, policies, data, metrics, triage, reporting and day-to-day service delivery.
* Manages the triage queue for incoming legal requests and oversees completion of assigned work directly, while coordinating workload across Hub personnel and balancing service quality, speed and capacity.
Designs, documents and continuously improves operating procedures for intake, assignment, first response, review, escalation, completion and reporting.  

**Regional Staffing & Work Allocation**

* Onboards, manages and develops a team of global contract managers and lawyers within the Hub through hands-on training, coaching, quality support and capacity planning.
* Coordinates regional coverage:
  + Two contract managers covering North America and EMEA hours;
  + One contract manager based in APAC who pulls from the Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) triage queue during working hours; and
  + A LATAM contract manager assigned as needed, often for language coverage.
* Assigns and coordinates lower-complexity work routed to EMEA and LATAM interns in partnership with the relevant legal supervisors, ensuring that work is scoped, tracked and appropriately reviewed.
* Works closely with regional legal supervisors on the legal aspects of Hub work and keeps operational ownership separate from legal judgment and escalation.
  + Coordinates practical coverage across regions and time zones, including handoffs, queue visibility and service-level expectations.
  + Identifies training, capacity and process gaps and works with regional supervisors to address them.
Maintains clear ownership for each request so that Hub personnel know when to handle work directly, seek operational support or escalate a legal question.  

**Intake, Triage & Contract Enablement**

* Manages CLM triage queue and maintains the rules for handling requests directly or assigning them to a Hub lawyer, Hub contract manager or commercial lawyer.
* Manages the Contracts Hub email alias for legal queries where no documentation is attached or needed and ensures each request is tracked, triaged and routed to the right owner.
* Collaborates closely with the Lead Counsel, Commercial AI & Contract Enablement, who owns legal content, templates, fallback positions, playbooks, escalation criteria and decision logic for legal AI tools; this role operationalizes those inputs through intake workflows, playbook adoption, CLM tooling and AI contract-review tool integration.
  + Feeds escalation, exception and playbook-deviation data back to the Lead Counsel to support improvements to playbooks, fallbacks and decision logic.
  + Partners with Legal Operations on CLM and AI tooling requirements, configuration and adoption; Legal Operations owns the primary contracting systems, tooling, workflow administration and administrative management of templates.
  + Works with legal, sales, deal desk, finance, procurement, Technology/IT and Legal Operations to make Hub workflows practical and adopted.
  Supports training and communications so that Hub personnel and business partners understand intake rules, available self-service options and operating procedures.

**Reporting, Metrics & Roadmap Delivery**

* Tracks request volume by region, request type and risk tier; time to assignment and first response; cycle time by tier; service-level agreement (SLA) attainment by region; escalation and playbook-deviation rates; self-service rate; tool adoption; stakeholder sentiment; and capacity and utilization to support resourcing decisions.
* Provides regular dashboards and operating updates to Commercial Legal leadership, highlighting trends, bottlenecks, service-level performance, resourcing needs and opportunities for process improvement.
Drives operational tracking and cross-functional partnership for the Contracts Hub roadmap, with accountability for progress, adoption and reporting rather than unilateral ownership of every outcome. Ongoing responsibilities include establishing and maintaining baseline reporting; supporting training and readiness; driving reductions in assignments to deal teams and commercial resource touches; expanding self-service; supporting NDA insourcing and related cost savings; improving first-pass review and cycle times; and coordinating related stakeholder materials and communications.  

  

**Boundary Clarification**

* This role owns Hub operations and execution. Although it may supervise personnel, including lawyers, it is not a legal authority and is not in the legal escalation path. Hub personnel escalate legal questions to the regional lawyers, who may not be the regional lead.

The Sales Operations Manager is responsible for working closely with the sales leadership team to define, implement, and manage processes that support Nextech’s sales growth plans. The Sales Operations Manager maintains documentation on sales processes, assists with on-boarding new sales reps, and optimizes sales productivity.

All activities must be in compliance with Equal Employment Opportunity laws, HIPAA, ERISA and other regulations, as appropriate.

* In addition to working in accordance with appropriate conduct and behavioral standards, specific responsibilities of this role include but are not limited to:

  + Liaise with other departments to ensure the smooth handoff of data.
  + Develop processes to track trends in the competitive landscape and maintain competitive insights.
  + Assist in evaluating emerging market opportunities.
  + Manage special projects to support sales and marketing with go-to-market initiatives.
  + Other responsibilities as defined by VP Sales Operations.

### **Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration or related field and/or related experience.
* 5 years proven ability to manage operational functions such as centralized sales support, reports and analysis.
* 5 Years of Salesforce experience.
* 5 years of BI, commission & automation tool experience; Ex: Gong, Everstage, Hubspot, Chilipiper, LinkedIn Navigator.
* Excellent organizational skills and ability to manage and prioritize a heavy workload in a fast-paced environment.
* Proven ability to present facts and recommendations effectively in verbal and written form.

jobs.title: Network Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us:**Effortless Office partners with our customers to make IT effortless so they can focus on their business. As a Hybrid Managed Services Provider (MSP) with a focus on providing world-class customer experience, we deliver and fully support secure cloud solutions as well as comprehensive managed IT and network services.

**About the Role:**

Effortless is looking for a Network Operations Manager who is an excellent leader and engineer. This is a player-coach role: you will lead our network engineering team while remaining one of the company's top escalation and design resources for enterprise, high-availability, multi-platform networks.

You will own the health, security, and continuous improvement of the networks we manage for our customers and within our own Switch data center infrastructure. We expect you to be proactive: you will not wait for tickets. You and your team will regularly review client environments, find risk, capacity, and performance gaps before they become outages, and bring clear, cost-effective recommendations to our customers and Service Delivery Teams.

The ideal candidate has served as a Senior Network Engineer, has the technical depth to earn the respect of senior engineers, and has the leadership skills to develop them. You set a high standard, communicate clearly, take ownership, and care about the customer experience.

**Position Details:**

**Reports to:** President

**Direct reports:** Network Engineers and Senior Network Engineers

**Location:** Remote with a preference for someone in/near Las Vegas, NV.

**Travel:** Some travel required for data center work, client site visits, and special projects.

**Schedule:** Monday - Friday 8:00-5:00 PST, with 24/7 escalation availability for major incidents and management of the team's on-call rotation.

**Benefits:**

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401K + employer match
* Paid time off and holidays
* Opportunities for career growth and development
* Training and certification support

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

### **Engineering Excellence**

* Serves as the company's senior network engineering authority and final escalation point in core routing and switching, network security, and network diagnostics.
* Designs, reviews, and approves complex network configurations and architecture, including hardware and software technology, site locations, business continuity, disaster recovery, and integration of technologies.
* Personally assesses and resolves the most complex data network problems and incidents, and leads major incident response through to resolution and root cause analysis.
* Owns the design, standards, and lifecycle of Effortless's own network infrastructure at our Switch data centers, including Cisco Nexus, Firepower, and SDWAN (Meraki and Cisco Viptela) environments.
* Sets and maintains network engineering standards, configuration baselines, and documentation requirements in IT Glue, and reviews the team's work for quality and consistency.
* Reviews analyses and technical feasibility to develop data network deployment strategies, resource requirements, and cost estimates.

### **Proactive Client Improvement**

* Leads a regular program of proactive network reviews across client environments to find security, reliability, capacity, and performance gaps before they cause issues.
* Uses Auvik monitoring, ticket trends in Autotask, and assessment data to identify recurring problems and drive permanent fixes rather than repeated reactive work.
* Assesses data network growth forecasts and ensures business needs are translated into network capacity requirements.
* Partners with Service Delivery Managers, Technical Account Managers, and ESAs to turn findings into clear, cost-effective recommendations for each client's technology roadmap.
* Tracks hardware and firmware end-of-life, vulnerabilities, and configuration drift across managed networks and plans remediation.
* Brings the customer's perspective to every recommendation: leads with business outcomes, not technology features.

### **Leadership**

* Hires, onboards, coaches, and develops Network Engineers and Senior Network Engineers, including technical mentoring and certification planning.
* Sets clear expectations, holds regular 1-on-1s, conducts performance reviews, and holds the team accountable using EOS tools (Rocks, Scorecards, Issues, To-Dos) in Strety.
* Manages team workload, project priorities, and resource availability, and plans and coordinates cross-functional or cross-company work.
* Owns network change management: reviews and approves changes, maintenance windows, and rollback plans.
* Manages the team's 24/7 on-call rotation and escalation process, and ensures after-hours coverage meets Effortless's service standards.
* Communicates status, risk, and outcomes clearly to leadership, Service Delivery Teams, and customers, following our CWC (Communicate, Work, Communicate) value.

### **Operations and Compliance**

* Defines, tracks, and reports on network operations KPIs (see Success Measures below).
* Manages relationships with network vendors and carriers, including escalations, and supports procurement and licensing decisions.
* Ensures all compliance aspects of the position and team are known and followed; understands and complies with all policies, codes, and regulations applicable to the position and company, including client HIPAA, PCI, and NIST requirements.
* Maintains sensitive and confidential information regarding company and customer information.
* Performs related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications:**

### **Education and Work Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, or a related technical field
* 10+ years of experience with Service Provider, MSP, or enterprise networking or general telecommunications
* 3+ years in a Senior Network Engineer (or equivalent) role, serving as the top escalation and design resource for complex networks (required)
* 2+ years l

jobs.title: Webinar Producer & Virtual Event Operations Manager
jobs.description:
The Fiber Broadband Association is the largest organization in the world solely focused on accelerating the deployment of fiber optics broadband communications. The Fiber Broadband Association provides advocacy, education, and resources to companies, organizations, and communities who want to deploy the best networks through fiber to the home, fiber to the business and fiber everywhere. Fiber Broadband Association members represent the entire broadband ecosystem: service providers, suppliers, contractors, consultants, consumers, policymakers, high-tech companies, and application providers.

DESCRIPTION:

While our advocacy is DC-based, our employees can work from anywhere they can be the most productive. The FBA professional staff is currently a small team, but we have many contributors from our 600+ member companies in North America and over 100 companies in Latin America. The Fiber Broadband Association is seeking qualified applications for our Webinar Producer & Virtual Events Operations Manager position. We are looking for a self-starting, detail-oriented, independent team member with a poised, outgoing personality who can adapt to any situation. Webinar Producer & Virtual Events Operations Manager position will plan, promote, produce, and deliver of a series of Fiber Broadband Association webinars and virtual events, including Fiber for Breakfast, educational webinars, and committee and working group webinars. This role will develop, solicit sponsors, secure speakers, and publish a webinar calendar aimed at maximizing number of programs delivered, sponsorship revenue, and increasing overall webinar attendance. The Producer will be responsible for collaborating with subject matter experts to identify content and develop and manage the webinars program. Collaborate with the Marketing team to develop and identifying venues and methods of delivery to drive new business and have knowledge of budgets metrics for performance tracking. This role will also work to streamline processes for efficiency and cost savings.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND ACTIVITIES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:

* Own the lifecycle for one-hour video webinar production (140+ webinars annually) including but not limited to scheduling, creating registration pages, producing eblasts, preparing social media post collateral, writing webinar scripts, creating PowerPoint decks, leading prep calls with guest speakers, and executing webinars
* Fulfill the full scope of deliverables and branding owed to sponsors and Premier members for one-hour webinars; serve as the primary contact for members and non-members as well as speakers and registrants; follow through on responding to requests, questions, and provide timely customer service
* Hosting responsibilities and/or Q&A moderation and housekeeping remarks duties on- screen for video webinars
* Trained as an organizer on the ON24 platform for live and pre-recorded webinars
* Distributing new contacts from webinars to Membership Team in a timely manner post-webinar
* Identify, recruit, and book guests for the weekly Fiber for Breakfast podcast, sourcing industry leaders, members, and partners whose expertise aligns with timely fiber broadband topics
* Writing virtual event recap emails with results/metrics, documenting webinar metrics, and sending thank you e-notes to participants post-webinar
* Adding events to website calendar and website resource section (i.e. webinar replay, presentations) on www.fiberbroadband.org
* Coordinate with FBA Board members, FBA committee members, and FBA partners serving as guest speakers on 30-minute and one-hour webinars
* Serve as a secondary member of the Fiber for Breakfast weekly webinar series production team and step up as a backup for the lead role, when necessary
* Travel to annual Fiber Connect conference (June 2027), Premier Member Meeting (December 2027), and potential domestic travel to 1-3 Regional Fiber Connect events throughout the year (2027)
* Duties as assigned for other live events

ESSENTIAL SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:

* High technology aptitude and comfort on webinar platform and other components of a tech stack (including Association Management Software like, Impexium)
* Strong writer and proofreader
* Extraordinary attention to detail
* On-screen presence and charisma
* Relationship-builder
* Commitment to delivering an exceptional customer experience
* Prioritize quality control of virtual event experience for FBA community
* Previous experience in webinar production, event planning, project management, member services, customer experience, and/or an association a definite plus!
* Other responsibilities to be determined based on the needs of the organization and the skills and experience of the chosen applicant.

REQUIREMENTS:

* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in business administration, marketing, communications, or related field.
* Experience in working with cross-functional teams on multiple projects with demonstrably successful deliverables. Experience developing, delivering, and producing webinars or Live Virtual training required.
* Demonstrable experience building successful working relationships with internal and external project teams.
* Superior project management skills – experience successfully managing multiple projects and stakeholders in various stages of development required.
* Experience with digital marketing, blogs, archiving, podcasts, streaming

Pay: $70,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Clinical Trial Manager – Clinical Operations
jobs.description:
For over 25 years, dicentra has been a trusted global leader in regulatory consulting and clinical research for the life sciences and dietary supplement industries. We partner with innovators worldwide to navigate complex regulatory landscapes, turn scientific rigor into commercial success, and bring safe, compliant products to market.

We have an immediate opening for an experienced Clinical Trial Manager to oversee active clinical trial programs, trial site operations, and monitoring activities. We are open to full-time or part-time fixed-term employment, as well as independent consulting arrangements, depending on the candidate’s experience and availability.

**The Opportunity**

In this role, you will take operational ownership of Phase I–IV clinical studies. You will oversee clinical site management, coordinate site monitoring, troubleshoot clinic-level challenges, ensure ICH-GCP compliance, and work cross-functionally with data management and trial vendors to hit study milestones on schedule.

You will also serve as a key point of contact for sponsors, investigators, and external partners, ensuring effective communication and timely resolution of study-related challenges.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Trial Planning & Execution: Plan, initiate, and manage clinical studies in compliance with ICH-GCP, study protocols, and company SOPs, ensuring study timelines, budgets, and deliverables are met.
* Monitoring & Site Management: Coordinate clinical site monitoring activities, verify data integrity, and support clinical trial sites directly.
* Clinic Problem Resolution: Act as primary escalation contact for trial sites and clinical staff, proactively troubleshooting deviations, patient recruitment hurdles, and operational bottlenecks.
* Vendor & Data Coordination: Collaborate with Data Management and trial vendors on CRF review, EDC user acceptance testing (UAT), query resolution, and database lock.
* Ethics & Regulatory Submissions Support: Support site-level IRB/REB submissions, essential document collection, and inspection-readiness maintenance.
* Clinical Documentation Oversight: Review and provide operational input on study protocols, informed consent forms, and other essential clinical trial documentation.

**Qualifications & Background**

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Health Sciences, Nursing, or related field.
* Experience: 5+ years of clinical research experience, with at least 3+ years in clinical trial management or senior CRA/site monitoring roles within a CRO or sponsor environment.
* Regulatory Acumen: Deep working knowledge of ICH-GCP guidelines and Health Canada / FDA clinical trial operational requirements.
* Execution Focus: Strong project management abilities, organizational skills, and a track record of driving trials to database lock.
* Sponsor & Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated ability to independently manage sponsor relationships, coordinate cross-functional teams, and resolve complex clinical trial challenges.

**Why join us**

**Best Workplace**
  
*We nourish an environment devoted to honesty and fairness, trust and respect. We care deeply for our team members and take work-life balance seriously, allowing our people to decide on a schedule that best fits their life and working preferences.*

**Best People**
  
*We unite cross-industry professionals with a shared passion for improving people’s health and wellness. Our inspiring leaders are accessible and work eagerly side-by-side with individual employees to help them understand and achieve their objectives.*

**Best Opportunities**
  
*We encourage our team members to continuously develop and enhance their skills and expertise. We recognize and reward courageous choices and innovative ideas that result in the growth of our people and company, and the success of our clients.*

**Become a part of a purpose-driven and future-oriented business that impacts and improves millions of lives worldwide!**

**Job Type:** Full-Time Employment, Part-Time Employment, or Independent Consulting Contract (Project-Based / Ad-Hoc)

**Location:** Ontario (Fully Remote)

**How to Apply**

This position is available to fill immediately.

We welcome applications from qualified professionals interested in full-time or part-time fixed-term employment, as well as independent consulting arrangements. Please indicate your preferred engagement arrangement and availability when applying.

Applying:

As part of the hiring process, in addition to interviewing, successful candidates may be required to complete a skills assessment and a reference/background check. If you are sent a skills assessment, please complete it for consideration for the advertised position.

We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
About the Role:

Culmen International is seeking a **Program Manager** to support an Air Force contract.

The Program Manager provides overall leadership, authority, and accountability for the contract and associated task orders. This key role leads the Program Management Office, serves as the principal interface with the Contracting Officer and Government Program Manager, and directs planning, staffing, deployment, subcontract management, quality, safety, security, property, cost, schedule, and performance activities.

The Program Manager must be available to support urgent requirements and globally dispersed operations.

What You’ll Do in Your New Role:

* Lead and maintain a fully staffed Program Management Office and execute the accepted AFCAP Management Plan.
* Provide executive oversight of multiple concurrent task orders in geographically dispersed CONUS and OCONUS locations.
* Maintain 24/7 program responsiveness and ensure an authorized representative responds to the Contracting Officer by telephone within one hour of notification.
* Direct rapid proposal development and mobilization for routine and urgent requirements, including unusual and compelling urgency actions.
* Coordinate staffing, deployment, contracts, security, procurement, quality control, safety, property, and subcontract management functions.
* Ensure compliance with contract requirements, task-order requirements, security obligations, cybersecurity standards, ethics requirements, CTIP, host-nation laws, and applicable federal and DoD regulations.
* Establish governance for schedule, cost, risk, performance metrics, reporting, corrective actions, and continuous improvement.
* Oversee Site Managers and task-order teams and confirm that key personnel and deployed staff meet qualification, clearance, training, medical, and readiness requirements.
* Manage Government and customer relationships and provide timely, transparent status, risk, and decision information.
* Maintain accurate key-contact information and notify the Government of proposed key-personnel changes within required timeframes.

Required Qualifications:

* Current active Secret security clearance.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, construction management, logistics, program management, or a related field.
* 5+ years of program management experience within the last seven years.
* Demonstrated expertise in Government appropriations.
* Experience with Air Force Mission Support functions—particularly Engineering and Force Support—or equivalent large-scale DoD installation services and base operations support.
* Experience managing construction, services, and commodities requirements.
* Strong knowledge of Government acquisition processes.
* Demonstrated experience simultaneously managing multiple task orders valued above $2 million each in geographically dispersed locations, or equivalent deployment experience.
* Ability to lead global, time-sensitive operations and communicate effectively with senior Government, customer, partner, and subcontractor stakeholders.

Desired Qualifications:

* Master's degree
* PMP or comparable program-management certification.
* Experience with contingency contracting, expeditionary operations, IDIQ programs, and cost-reimbursable and firm-fixed-price task orders.

About the Company:

Culmen International is committed to enhancing international safety and security, strengthening homeland defense, advancing humanitarian missions, and optimizing government operations. With experience in over 150 countries, Culmen supports our clients to accomplish critical missions in challenging environments.
