jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Bamboo Health is the leader in Real-Time Care Intelligence™ solutions aimed at improving lives for everyone experiencing physical and behavioral health challenges. We are driven by our mission to empower clients to deliver seamless, high-quality and cost-effective care during pivotal moments to improve health outcomes. From coast to coast, Bamboo Health partners with all major retail pharmacy chains, 52 states and territories, 100% of the top 10 best hospitals and more than half of the country’s largest health plans to improve more than 1 billion patient encounters annually. Join us in improving lives during pivotal care moments!

**Summary:**

Bamboo Health is building a team of compassionate clinicians and leaders who are committed to improving care access to those in most need. We are seeking a seasoned, highly motivated Senior Project Manager who can bridge clinical, operational, and technical workstreams across provider and payor organizations. This role owns end-to-end project delivery—from initial scoping through go-live and post-launch stabilization—while consulting directly with customers on workflow design to drive results and accelerate implementation timelines. In addition to leading individual implementations, you will manage a portfolio of partner engagements, balancing competing priorities, risks, and stakeholder needs while helping scale implementation best practices across the organization. The ideal candidate brings a strong mix of project management and client success experience, deep healthcare delivery knowledge, and the judgment to work independently with minimal oversight, comfortably tailoring communication across a variety of stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

**What You’ll Do:**

  

* Own the full implementation lifecycle for new provider or payor partners, working independently and with minimal oversight to ensure all milestones, deliverables, and outcomes are met on time and within scope.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for external partners, including health systems, provider networks, and payors.
* Partner with customers and internal clinical and operational teams to design workflows, staffing models, referral pathways, and escalation processes that support successful implementation and accelerate time to value.
* Collaborate with data integration and IT teams to enable connectivity with EHRs, care management platforms, and analytics tools.
* Guide partners through workflow changes, training, and adoption planning to drive results and ensure smooth go-live transitions.
* Maintain project plans and status reports, as well as risks and issues logs.
* Tailor communication of progress, dependencies, and mitigation plans across audiences, from junior project managers to executive leadership, both internally and externally.
* Capture lessons learned and feedback to refine implementation methodology, mentor less experienced project managers, and accelerate future rollouts.
* Manage a portfolio of concurrent implementations, balancing timelines, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder priorities to ensure successful delivery.
* Identify repetitive tasks and partner with team leads to implement scalable automation solutions.

**What Success Looks Like…**

**In 3 months…**

* Take ownership of at least one active implementation, serving as the primary customer contact while maintaining accurate status reporting, risk management, and stakeholder communication.
* Build strong relationships with key internal and external stakeholders and identify opportunities to improve workflows, processes, or implementation efficiency.
* Identify at least one opportunity in your role to pilot or apply AI or automation (e.g., streamlining a task, summarizing data, generating content).

**In 6 months…**

* Independently manage a portfolio of concurrent implementations, consistently delivering key milestones on time and within scope.
* Lead partners through workflow design, operational readiness, training, adoption planning, and go-live execution.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to customers while mentoring less experienced project managers and contributing implementation best practices across the team.

**In 12 months…**

* Deliver multiple successful go-lives with measurable post-launch stabilization, such as partner adoption targets met and time to value shortened compared with baseline.
* Capture lessons learned across your implementations and contribute at least two lasting improvements to our implementation playbook, templates, or tools.
* Be recognized as a go-to leader for complex implementations, influencing customer outcomes, supporting executive-level partner relationships, and helping elevate implementation excellence across the organization.

**What You Need:**

* Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of combined experience in healthcare project management and account/client success, preferably with exposure to behavioral health, care coordination, or population health in technology enabled services.
* Proven success independently leading complex implementations or partnerships involving provider organizations, payors, or health IT vendors, with minimal oversight.
* Experience with EHR integrations, referral management workflows, or value-based care initiatives strongly preferred.
* A consultative, proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with strong attention to detail.
* Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity, solve complex problems, and independently drive projects forward in dynamic environments.
* Strongly empathetic with a keen desire to reduce barriers to behavioral health and social services for the underserved.
* Ability to convey technical information and tailor communication across a range of audiences and levels, from junior project managers to clinicians, administrators, and C-level executives, exercising strong, independent judgment in what and how to communicate with customers.
* PMP (Project Management Professional, PMI) is preferred.

jobs.description:
**About KHM**  
Karsh Hagan Madden (KHM) is an independent marketing agency formed through the merger of Karsh Hagan and Madden Media with 5 decades of creative and strategic legacy with 1 unified shop!

We blend bold storytelling with precision media, PR, geospatial targeting, and observation-led strategy to help brands close the gap between how they are seen and how they are felt. Madden built our reputation in destination marketing and tourism. Karsh has spent years building brands in healthcare, banking, higher education, and retail alongside it. Together, we believe the strongest brands build communities, and our goal is to differentiate them in a world where consumers want something that means something to them.

Find out more at https://khm.agency

**About You**  
You're an experienced project manager and account lead who thrives on bringing structure to complex website builds and digital marketing ecosystems. You've **likely** held at least **3+ years of experience** and you keep people, timelines, and quality at the center of everything you do. You enjoy turning big ideas into clear, actionable plans and have a proven track record of **navigating ambiguity and wrangling complex projects, client expectations, and cross-functional teams**-even when priorities shift mid-stream.

You bring a blend of **project management rigor and client-facing account management experience**. You know how to build trust, lead client conversations, and advocate for both the client's goals and the agency's boundaries. While web design and development are your primary domain, you're equally comfortable taking on **MarTech implementations, systems integrations, and broader digital marketing initiatives**.  
  
You are methodology-flexible: you understand structured Waterfall planning for large-scale site builds, but you seamlessly pull in **Agile practices and iterative workflows** to keep work moving efficiently. Above all, you're an organized, proactive problem solver who knows how to herd cats, clear roadblocks, and keep every stakeholder aligned.

**About the Job**  
As our **WebMarTech Project Manager**, you'll lead the end-to-end planning, coordination, and execution of complex website builds and digital technology projects for our clients. Working within our integrated marketing agency, you'll serve as both the operational hub and a core client partner, ensuring projects are delivered on time, on budget, and with exceptional quality.

While **websites make up the core of what you'll manage**, your portfolio will also include key **MarTech initiatives** (such as CRM setups, marketing automation builds, analytics integrations, and custom web tools) as well as supporting marketing deliverables like campaign landing pages, digital media assets, and interactive experiences.  
  
In this role, you won't just track tasks-you will **drive complex deliverables, manage client relationships, and navigate shifting requirements** to keep teams focused and projects moving steadily across the finish line.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* **Lead End-to-End Delivery:** Own web design/development projects and MarTech initiatives through every phase-discovery, architecture, design, dev, testing, launch, and post-launch support.
* **AccountClient Management:** Serve as a direct, trusted contact for clients. Manage expectations, run status calls, facilitate key feedback cycles, and proactively communicate progress, risks, and changes.
* **WrangleNavigate:** Act as the operational glue that pulls together internal teams (designers, developers, strategists, content creators, QA) and client stakeholders, navigating competing priorities and keeping everyone aligned.
* **ProjectResource Planning:** Build and maintain flexible project roadmaps, resource allocations, sprint boards, scope documents, and budgets.
* **AgileFlexible PM Execution:** Adapt project management approaches based on the engagement-utilizing structured roadmaps for site builds while applying Agile principles to iteratively manage dev backlogs, technical revisions, and MarTech integrations.
* **ScopeScope Creep Management:** Clearly define deliverables and manage change requests, gracefully balancing client satisfaction with scope and budget boundaries.
* **Proactive Problem Solving:** Identify technical, timeline, or resource risks early. Develop mitigation plans and clear team roadblocks before they disrupt momentum.
* **QualityProcess Control:** Ensure all agency deliverables meet strict quality and functional standards before hitting the client's inbox. Continuously refine internal workflows to make delivery smoother.

**What You Need to Succeed**

* **WebMarTech PM Experience:** Proven track record managing complex custom website builds, web platforms, and marketing technology/integration projects within a marketing or digital agency.
* **Account Management Background:** Hands-on experience in client-facing account management-comfortable leading client meetings, navigating difficult conversations, and maintaining strong client relationships.
* **Flexible Agile Approach:** Solid experience with Agile workflows (e.g., managing backlogs, sprint planning, iterative delivery) alongside traditional milestone-based project planning.
* **Mastery in WranglingNavigation:** Demonstrated ability to manage multi-faceted projects, wrangle cross-functional creative/technical teams, and comfortably navigate shifting client requirements without losing control of the budget or timeline.
* **Technical Savvy:** High technical literacy when it comes to CMS platforms, website architecture, APIs, CRM/marketing automation tools, and web development lifecycles.
* **CommunicationNegotiation:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a talent for translating technical details into clear business concepts for clients.
* **Agency Mindset:** A proactive, resilient, and solutions-oriented mindset built for a fast-paced agency environment.

jobs.description:
Karman is a fast-growing NVIDIA-backed AI company enabling AI data centers to dynamically orchestrate power and unlock more compute capacity from existing energy infrastructure. For over a decade, we have applied AI to the electric grid — bringing real-time visibility and power-flow control to complex energy infrastructure. Our Karman platform, built on a custom NVIDIA module, brings that same capability to AI data centers, giving operators a way to better use the power already available to them.  
  
We are seeking an experienced Customer Program Manager to lead customer-facing programs for the Karman platform, from initial evaluation through pilot deployment, design win, and long-term adoption. This role combines program management discipline with strong customer engagement skills, acting as the single point of accountability across customers, Engineering, Product, Sales, and executive teams. You'll join a diverse team of experts who are mission-driven, collaborative and adaptive, working at the intersection of AI infrastructure and power systems.  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and single point of accountability for Karman customer programs, ensuring deliverables, timelines, and milestones are met from initial engagement through pilot deployment, design win, and scale-out.

* Establish trusted advisor relationships with customer stakeholders at technical, business, and executive levels, driving clarity in customer requirements and translating them into actionable internal deliverables.
* Coordinate joint planning sessions and program update meetings with customers throughout the Karman pilot lifecycle.
* Partner with Solutions Architects and Application Engineers to align resources for customer success, and interface with Product Management to relay customer feedback and influence roadmap priorities.

* Manage change control across customer programs, ensuring scope, cost, and schedule integrity.

**Minimum Qualifications**

Big Blue Marble Academy (BBMA) is an early childhood development and education leader with more than 90 schools across 9 states. Our programs include early care, childcare, preschool, and after-school care designed around what a child needs for their age and stage of development. Our curriculum is focused on global education and teaching children the importance of giving back and helping others in need. We the structure and encouragement children need to foster their curiosity and love of learning. Our teachers provide children with hands-on activities preparing them for success in school.

**Quality Assurance Manager Job Description**

The Quality Assurance Manager (QA) plays a critical role in risk prevention, safety and compliance, all of which help ensure operational excellence across BBMA’s portfolio of schools. Working in connection with school management and higher levels of BBMA Operations, this position plays a critical role in “left-of-loss” risk prevention, and ensuring ongoing compliance with safety, and regulatory initiatives while driving consistency, quality, and continuous improvement to ensure each school meets and exceeds BBMA’s standards.

The QA Manager works collaboratively across departments to ensure schools feel fully supported as they enhance overall operational quality, fostering a culture of accountability, partnership, and continuous growth.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Lead and execute quality assurance audits across all locations identifying compliance gaps

* Predict and prevent risks before they materialize

* Establish and track KPIs and report trends and build early-warning systems and predictive models related to quality, compliance and service delivery

* Partner proactively with all levels of BBMA Operations to ensure assigned schools operate in compliance with federal, state, and local laws, and childcare licensing regulations - evaluate performance against standards

* Develop, train, implement, and maintain standard operating procedures and best practices - develop risk-awareness culture and scenario-based readiness

* Monitor adherence to company policies, safety standards, and licensing requirements

* Identify opportunities to improve consistency, efficiency, and overall school performance

* Analyze operational and other data to drive improvements in quality

* Support all levels of BBMA Operations through coaching and ongoing development

* Create and manage training content within the Learning Management System (LMS)

* Conduct regular site visits (60-75% travel) to evaluate school performance

* Identify recurring issues and partner with leadership to implement sustainable solutions

* Develop and manage auditing tools, reporting systems, and tracking processes

* Review parent and staff feedback to improve service quality and experience

* Prepare detailed reports on audit findings, trends, and improvement plans

* Communicate insights and recommendations to senior leadership and other key stakeholders

* Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure alignment and successful implementation of initiatives

* Lead special projects related to quality, compliance, and operational improvements

* Maintain confidentiality of all company information and data

**Educational and Experience Requirements**

* A Bachelor’s degree with a preference for an additional certification in Certified Risk Management Professional (CRMP), Risk Management Professional (RMP), Certified Materials & Resource Professional (CMRP), Certified Safety and Health Manager (CSHM), OSHA Safety and Health Fundamentals, Certified Risk Manager (CRM) and similar certifications

jobs.title: PSR Quality Leader
jobs.description:
The Power Sensing and Regulation Product Line Quality Leader develops and deploys the global quality strategy for the Power Sensing and Regulation product line. The role covers quality planning, quality assurance, quality control and the Quality Management System across the full product lifecycle, from tendering and product development to sourcing, manufacturing, project execution and service.
  
The role is reporting to the Product Line Leader, and functionally to the Business Line Quality Leader. The Product Line Quality Leader functionally leads factory quality leaders and collaborates with engineering, operations, sourcing, project and business leaders. The role is accountable for a strong quality culture, high customer satisfaction, prevention of customer escapes and continuous improvement of product and process quality.

**Job Description**
===================

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and deploy the global quality strategy, priorities and governance for the Power Sensing and Regulation product line, in full alignment with Power Transmission’s Quality roadmap.

* Drive the Zero-Defect Framework towards Level 4 through clear action plans, standard work, capability building and regular progress reviews.

* Ensure holistic integration of the factories' Quality Management Systems into Power Transmission's Business Management System. Take an active role in shaping the QMS to support the evolution of the business, in partnership with Power Transmission's central functions.

* Functionally lead and coach the factory quality teams. Set common standards, operating rhythms, measures and expectations across sites, and be accountable for meeting the Product Line Quality KPI targets.

* Be accountable for fulfilling quality engineering requirements during New Product Introduction (NPI) in the Product Line. Cover the full process from Design FMEA and Process FMEA through Control Plans and Reaction Plans, and drive aligned quality-built-in roadmaps across the Product Line.

* Lead complex global customer complaints and root cause analyses. Ensure rapid containment, clear customer communication, verified root cause and sustainable corrective action.

* Apply lessons learned and read across with factories and functions. Ensure relevant learning is built into risk analyses, standards and process controls.

* Drive a strong problem-solving culture using structured methods such as 8D, 5 Why, Ishikawa and fault-tree analysis.

* Use digital tools, data analytics and AI to improve prevention, traceability, risk detection and decision-making.

* Manage and drive the Customer Experience (CX) roadmap for the Product Line. Translate customer feedback and quality performance into clear priorities and improvement actions.

* Monitor and improve customer escapes, cost of poor quality, complaint closure, audit findings and first-pass yield.

* Build strong cross-functional teams with technical experts and business leaders to solve quality issues and deliver improvement plans.

**Qualifications and Experience**

In this role, you won't just follow a static blueprint—you will help build it. We are seeking a highly proactive partner program manager to drive exceptional experiences for our Systems Integrators (SIs), ISVs, Resell, and Technology partners. You will take the lead on optimizing the end-to-end partner journey, managing cross-functional projects, and eliminating operational friction.

This position requires a "can-do" attitude and a passion for continuous improvement. You will be responsible for transforming manual workflows into automated, scalable systems, managing key vendor capabilities, and implementing strategic initiatives that directly unlock ecosystem revenue velocity.

**Responsibilities**

In this role, you’ll:

* **Drive Program Modernization & Scale:** Act as an operational engine for the team, identifying process bottlenecks and proactively designing new ways to automate existing manual workflows.
* **Own Problem-Solving:** Step into complex challenges across the partner lifecycle and chart a clear path forward to build repeatable, programmatic solutions.
* **Optimize the Partner Experience:** Lead and refine core partner onboarding pathways, lifecycle touchpoints, and support workflows to deliver a seamless, world-class journey for external ecosystems.
* **Accelerate Partner Revenue Mechanics:** Build and execute operational frameworks that eliminate transaction friction, streamline incentive administration, and maximize partner-sourced revenue pipelines.
* **Manage Technology & Vendor Capabilities:** Serve as a strategic owner for key components of our partner tech stack and vendor relationships, ensuring our data models and tools are optimized for ecosystem scale rather than mere maintenance.
* **Orchestrate High-Touch Communications:** Develop and execute comprehensive partner engagement strategies, ensuring clear, accessible program documentation, impactful updates, and consistent enablement communications across all segments.
* **Lead Cross-Functional Project Execution:** Develop and run end-to-end project plans for new partner initiatives, collaborating closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, Legal, and Tech teams to ensure alignment and timely milestone delivery.

**Qualifications**

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

* **Required:**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field; relevant experience may be considered.
* **Experience:** 5–8 years of experience in partner program or project management, partner management, strategy and operations, or a similar role within a fast-paced technology company.
* **The "Get-Stuff-Done" Mindset:** A proven track record of operating effectively in complex environments, turning ambiguous problems into plans, and delivering results without a rigid instructions script.
* **Project Management & Collaboration:** Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage complex cross-functional timelines, align diverse stakeholders, and drive accountability.
* **Communication & Content:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills for translating complex program guidelines into clear, compelling partner assets, guides, and updates.

**Desired:**

* **Ecosystem Acumen:** Solid understanding of modern partner program structures, lifecycle methodologies, and experience working with SIs, ISVs, Resell, or Technology tracks.

jobs.description:
The START Center for Cancer Research (“START”) is the world’s largest early phase site network, fully dedicated to oncology clinical research. Throughout our history, START has provided hope to cancer patients in global community practices by offering **"Hope Through Access”** to cutting edge trials throughout the United States and Europe.

We are hiring for a **Regulatory Operations Specialist (Remote)** who will prepare and submit documents for new and existing studies to the Institutional Review Board (IRB), US Food and Drug Administration (FDA), and Institutional Biosafety Committee (IBC) for review, maintain the Investigator Site File (ISF) for assigned investigational drug studies and corresponding documents at START USA sites.

This is a remote role. The hourly pay for this remote role is $25 - $28/hour. However, base pay may vary depending on multiple individualized factors including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

**Essential Responsibilities**

* Prepare and submit new studies, including drafting the informed consent (IC), to the IRB as assigned under supervision. Serve as primary point of contact with the Sponsor/CRO in negotiating the IC for IRB submission. Serve as the main point of contact with the IRB for the studies. Enter work activity in Regulatory Operations tracking system(s) and generate status reports as required. Respond to inquiries and follow up on pending items.
* Prepare and submit study documents to the IRB for assigned studies under supervision. This includes, but is not limited to, revised protocols, revised investigator’s brochures, protocol clarification letters/memos, revised ICs, new ICs, continuing review reports, closure reports, serious adverse events, IND safety reports, unanticipated problems, protocol deviations, waivers, etc. Serve as the main point of contact with the IRB for the studies. Enter work activity in Regulatory Operations tracking system(s) and generate status reports as required. Respond to inquiries and follow up on pending items.
* Prepare and submit study documents to the Institutional Biosafety Committee (IBC) as assigned under supervision. Serve as the main point of contact with the IBC for the studies. Enter work activity in Regulatory Operations tracking system(s), note pending information and generate status reports as required. Respond to inquiries and follow up, as required, on pending items.
* Prepare and submit Expanded Access Studies to the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) as assigned under supervision. Serve as the main point of contact with the FDA and IRB for the studies. Enter work activity in Regulatory Operations tracking system(s) and generate status reports as required. Respond to inquiries and follow up, as required, on pending items.
* Maintain ISF (paper and/or electronic) for assigned studies. This includes, but not limited to, IRB submissions, IRB approvals, and correspondence.

  

**Required Education and Experience:**

* High School Diploma/GED.
* 5 years of experience in a regulatory research setting.
* Proficient working knowledge of Microsoft Outlook 365.
* Prior experience with regulatory document management system (i.e. Veeva, Advarra E-Reg).
* Strong organizational skills and a sense of timeliness in completing projects.
* Strong knowledge of medical and clinical research terminology.

  

**Preferred Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree.

  

**Best-in-Class Benefits and Perks**

We value our employees’ time and efforts. Our commitment to your success is enhanced by a competitive compensation, depending on experience, and an extensive benefits package including:

* Comprehensive health coverage: Medical, dental, and vision insurance provided
* Robust retirement planning: 401(k) plan available with employer matching
* Financial security: Life and disability insurance for added protection
* Flexible financial options: Health savings and flexible spending accounts offered
* Well-being and work-life balance: Paid time off, flexible schedule, and remote work choices provided
* Plus, we work to maintain the best environment for our employees, where people can learn and grow with the company. We strive to provide a collaborative, creative environment where everyone feels encouraged to contribute to our processes, decisions, planning, and culture.

  

**More About START**

  

START clinical trial sites have conducted more than 1,000 early-phase clinical trials, including dozens of therapies that were approved by the FDA or EMA. START represents the world’s largest roster of early-phase principal investigators across its Network of clinical trial sites. Committed to accelerating passage from trials to treatments, START delivers hope to patients, families, and physicians around the world via our mission of “Hope Through Access”.

Learn more at STARTresearch.com.

**Ready to be part of a team changing the future of cancer treatment?**

new_jobs.title: Global Supply Chain Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a Global Supply Chain Operations Manager to drive end-to-end supply chain execution for hardware programs supporting Meta's portfolio of consumer devices, data center infrastructure, and emerging technologies including virtual reality, augmented reality, and wearable platforms. In this role, you will lead cross-functional efforts to manage supplier ecosystems, ensure component supply continuity, and align sourcing strategies with product development and manufacturing timelines across complex, high-volume global programs.  
  
  

### **Global Supply Chain Operations Manager Responsibilities:**

* Define and execute commodity strategies for technically complex components including custom silicon, electromechanical assemblies, optical modules, display systems, and structural hardware used across Meta's hardware product lines
* Lead supplier engagement activities including demand versus supply assessments, manufacturing capability audits, capacity planning, and risk evaluations across global supply chains
* Partner with hardware engineering, new product introduction, and manufacturing operations teams to influence component architecture decisions and design-for-manufacturability trade-offs during early product development stages
* Establish supplier performance management frameworks including scorecards, structured business reviews, and corrective action plans tied to quality, delivery, cost, and responsiveness metrics
* Identify and mitigate supply chain risks arising from geopolitical factors, single-source dependencies, commodity market volatility, and supplier financial instability
* Drive multi-source supply strategies and qualification of alternate suppliers to improve supply chain resilience across critical component categories
* Collaborate with demand planning, logistics, and operations teams to align supplier capacity commitments and lead time targets with product ramp schedules and volume forecasts
* Develop and communicate commodity roadmaps and supply chain strategies to cross-functional partners and organizational leadership, influencing sourcing decisions at scale
* Support new product introduction programs by managing supplier ramp readiness, coordinating first article inspections, and tracking production validation milestones
* Leverage data analytics and supply chain platforms to monitor spend, track supplier performance trends, and surface actionable insights for continuous improvement

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in technical sourcing, commodity management, or supply chain operations within the hardware manufacturing industry
* Experience leading end-to-end supply chain execution for technically complex components, including supplier selection, negotiation, qualification, and lifecycle management
* Experience conducting manufacturing capability assessments, process audits, and supplier risk evaluations for high-volume production programs
* Experience collaborating cross-functionally with hardware engineering, quality engineering, new product introduction, and finance teams to align sourcing decisions with product and business requirements
* Experience developing and presenting commodity strategies, supply risk analyses, and supplier performance reports to cross-functional stakeholders

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Familiarity with responsible sourcing standards or supplier sustainability assessment frameworks applicable to global hardware supply chains
* Experience managing supply chains for consumer electronics or wearable hardware products, including components such as optical systems, display modules, or custom silicon
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize supply chain workflows and drive measurable impact such as efficiency gains, lead time reduction, or risk identification improvements
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience using enterprise procurement or supply chain platforms to manage supplier data, contract workflows, and commodity spend analytics
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Meta participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. new_jobs.title: Global Customer Revenue Strategy & Operations Manager (IM Org)
new_jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**

Rippling is hiring for a **Global Customer Revenue Strategy & Operations Manager** to manage critical customer sales strategy, operations and reporting capabilities for our Implementation organization (“IM”). This role will support the full design of Rippling’s Implementation business strategy and will monitor and report on execution to that strategy. This role will partner closely with senior leadership to build strategic business plans for the business. They will work to operationalize these plans throughout the year. They will own the build of critical business reporting and present on several cadences (weekly ad-hoc, monthly via the MBR, quarterly via strategy memo production). You will support a wide-range of post-sales operations including implementation forecasting, headcount & capacity planning, and oversee one of the largest organizations in the business. Lastly, you’ll collaborate closely with leadership across interconnected parts of the business (sales, marketing, customer experience) and be expected to cross-functionally partner with teams to manage business performance and surface key insights. This is a very exciting position located at the cross-section of several fast-paced and high-performing teams.

The ideal candidate will have worked in fast-paced environments before, ideally at a multi-product SaaS company and will have made a measurable impact to the sales organization. You should also be comfortable tackling ambiguous and challenging problems and working independently as well as part of a team. This is an opportunity to work on high-visibility strategic initiatives in a rapidly growing sales organization.

**This role will be based in our San Francisco, CA office and will require being in office 3x/week.**

**What you'll do**

* **Business Partner and Team Player:** Act as a business partner for CX & Sales Leadership. You will be a strategic thought partner and responsible for the operational cadence of the business. Coordinate with revenue operations teammates on systems and process improvements for the sales organization. Partner cross-functionally on key components of our annual planning process including modeling, target setting and reporting.
* **Strategic and Operational Planning:** Own financial model (capacity plan) for the IM organization. Lead building of detailed strategic and operational plans. Ensure modeling keeps pace with the evolving needs of the business. Support team in developing a robust understanding of the business. Drive plan operationalization.
* **Operational Management:** Operate at intersection of 750+ IM Managers who work within our SFDC instance. Design and implement new data capture strategies to improve operational efficiency. Manage several operational business models which track to Plan performance. Maintain team segmentation models and improve over time.
* **IM Workload Forecasting:** Own the bi-weekly IM Workload forecasting process. Lead/support weekly calls. Oversee forecasting performance and accuracy and increase both over time. Improve process over time and develop new ways to analyze the business.
* **Reporting:** Own monthly IM MBR reporting. Build, manage and share materials to executive leadership. Surface insights to leadership that are both quantified and actionable. Maintain deep knowledge of the business to ensure reporting accurately reflects state of the business as we scale. Design and build analytics to measure KPIs.
* **Ad-hoc analysis and project support:** Develop a deep understanding of the entire customer business at Rippling to inform your ability to provide ad hoc analysis support.Leverage data to surface key insights about the business and provide thoughtful, logical, sound recommendations to leadership.

**Qualifications**

* 3-5+ years of work experience in Consulting, Finance, Sales Operations, Sales Strategy, Sales Analytics or other related fields
* Requires Excel and financial modeling skills
* Requires SQL and BI experience; Salesforce experience is a nice to have
* Strong analytical, modeling, and conceptual problem-solving skills and ability to work with large data sets
* Proactive, self-starter with direct experience driving projects that deliver measurable impact to GTM teams
* Ability to work with a high degree of autonomy in a fast-moving startup or a hyper growth environment
* Excellent communication skills (written, verbal)
* Experience driving cross-functional initiatives with speed and efficiency
* Excellent cross-functional stakeholder management
* Strong Microsoft Excel / Google G-Sheets skills, familiarity with BI Tools (Tableau, Mode)

**Additional Information**

This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity.

A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed above.

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
105,000 - 175,000 USD per year(US Tier 1)

new_jobs.title: Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

**JOB OVERVIEW:**

The Operations Manager (OM) is responsible for the direct or indirect oversight and coordination of all operational functions in the Bay Area (San Jose and Oakland) grouping, resulting in a well-functioning, compliant operational environment. The Operations Manager serves as the primary liaison for HQ Regional Functional Leads including Supply Chain Advisor (SCA), Regional Safety & Security Director (RSSD), Regional IT Director (RITD) and Global Facilities Director (GFD). This position reports to the Executive Director and oversees the Operations staff in both offices. This position is based in either San Jose or Oakland, with regular weekly onsite presence within both offices.

**Major Responsibilities:**

**Safety & Security—S&S:**

* Oversee regional S&S matters.
* Responsible for the implementation and maintenance of all office S&S documentation.
* Organize all-staff S&S meetings at office or program site.
* Ensure that a minimum of one emergency evacuation is exercised at office or program site level per year and other appropriate trainings informed by Security Risk Assessment findings.
* Cascade HQ and/or office security warnings and advisories to staff, interns, and volunteers as needed.
* Report all S&S incidents involving covered persons in accordance with established protocols.
* Coordinate immediate incident management including filing police reports.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with other S&S actors or stakeholders, including but not limited to community organizations and partners, authorities, security and rescue services, and property owners.
* Assist in the development of office-specific S&S onboarding materials, ensuring the provision of S&S briefings to new staff and covered persons.

**Supply Chain—SC:**

* Serve as the region’s primary focal point for procurement, asset and inventory management, in-kind donations tracking and reporting, vehicle fleet management and transportation, and warehousing in accordance with established organizational and donor requirements.
* Lead the bidding process, including request for quotation process, request for proposal process, tender evaluation, and facilitating procurement committee functioning.
* Manage relationships with suppliers and vendors.
* Maintain up-to-date supplier and service provider records. Maintain asset register and inventory lists of purchased and donated items. Establish and manage inventory control for office supplies, stationery, and other consumables. In collaboration with the Finance Manager, ensure inventories reconcile with financial reports.
* Support program teams in meeting their match goals.
* Ensure policy compliance for the fleet of IRC-owned vehicles and oversee their maintenance and usage.
* Working with HQ Supply Chain to maintain IRC policy at all the times.
* Control and maintain the IRC policy through the PO system in Integra.

**Facilities Management:**

* Manage the region’s office and equipment leases, coordinate repairs and improvements with property managers, and lead the procurement of office equipment.
* Coordinate the allocation of workspaces and support related employee lifecycle needs such as building access.
* Support smooth functioning of office infrastructure including communications equipment and services.
* Assist with planning and coordinating office events and meetings.
* Responsible for coordinating on- and off-site storage needs.
* Maintain NorCal’s status with all counties related to annual property’s tax along with exemption status.

**Information Technology—IT:**

* Oversee grouping IT and communications infrastructure, hardware and software matters.
* Educate staff about IT support resources, including appropriate channels for incident reporting.
* Work with regional and HQ IT team to address any internet or telecommunications service disruptions, liaising with local internet and telecommunications service providers.
* Escalate any unresolved incidents or larger-scale IT projects (such as office moves or expansion) as needed.
* Ensure compliance with IT protocols, policies, and procedures including information security policy, IT procurement and asset management policy, acceptable use of IT resources policy, and new software procurement protocols.

**Other Duties**

* Provide mentorship and supervision to Operations staff, including leading team meetings, individual supervision and coaching, and conducting goal setting, and performance reviews.
* Approve Integra vendor creations and invoice journals.
* Coordinate with the Finance Director to manage administrative expenses and reports.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Key Working Relationships:**

* **Position reports to:** Executive Director
* **Position directly supervises:** Front Desk staff, Operations staff

**Job Requirements:**

* Undergraduate degree in business, non-profit management, public administration, or others related field preferred
* At least five years of related professional experience; preferably with refugee services and in a non-profit or social service environment
* Experience supervising staff preferred
* Demonstrated ability to work with deadlines and lead multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

new_jobs.title: Outpatient Therapy Operations Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
LGTC Group, P.C. is a CARF-accredited, multi-site behavioral health organization providing evidence-based mental health services across outpatient, IOP, PHP, and residential levels of care throughout the San Francisco Bay Area. We serve children, adolescents, and adults across Santa Clara County and beyond, with a multidisciplinary team committed to individualized, compassionate treatment that promotes lasting recovery and well-being.

**Job Overview**
----------------

The **Outpatient Therapy Operations Coordinator** is a pivotal operational role responsible for the day-to-day management of LGTC's outpatient therapy services across multiple locations. This position sits at the intersection of clinical operations and administrative systems — ensuring seamless scheduling, EHR compliance, credentialing coordination, regulatory adherence, and continuity of care for an active outpatient caseload.

The ideal candidate is operationally precise, comfortable with data, and able to work proactively across clinical, administrative, and leadership teams without requiring close supervision. Prior experience in behavioral health or healthcare operations is essential.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Scheduling & Calendar Management**

* Coordinate and maintain therapist calendars across all outpatient locations
* Manage scheduling for Group Therapy, Social Labs, and therapy provision at satellite locations (Oakland, Roseville, Willow St., San Bruno)

**EHR Administration & Compliance**

* Audit and oversee documentation completion in the electronic health record (EHR)
* Provide EHR technical support to clinical staff — including couples therapy charting, treatment plan templates, documentation workflows, and consent forms for specialized services (couples therapy agreements, MFT video recording, KAP meet-and-greet consents)
* Ensure form forwarding rules are correctly configured for associates and clinical supervisors
* Set up private pay agreements in EHR for clients assigned to interns
* Maintain website accuracy for associate therapist listings and supervisor information

**Credentialing & Staff Transitions**

* Proactively communicate associate therapist licensure status changes to initiate credentialing without delay
* Coordinate client coverage options during credentialing periods
* Ensure adherence to therapist offboarding and client transfer protocols to maintain continuity of care

**Case Management & Clinical Support**

* Provide ongoing case management for enrolled outpatient clients
* Support high-acuity cases in collaboration with clinical staff

**Data, Metrics & Reporting**

* Prepare reports and track program metrics including demand, capacity, and census
* Track therapist productivity and calculate bonuses
* Work with Informatics lead to track Kaiser MBC stats — conversion rates and time to intake/admission
* Track and follow up on therapist complaint inquiry forms
* Identify therapist hiring needs and growth opportunities based on demand data (in-person, virtual, specific modalities)

**Operations & Site Management**

* Coordinate multi-site furniture procurement and site setup
* Track site-level expense reports for therapy-related purchases across all locations
* Maintain regulatory and policy compliance documentation for CARF through SharePoint
* Identify and support process improvement initiatives

**Meetings & Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Facilitate and attend psychotherapist monthly and quarterly meetings
* Attend Ketamine Assisted Psychotherapy-specific weekly meetings
* Coordinate across departments and disciplines to support seamless outpatient operations
* Support staff training and onboarding

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree required
* Master's degree preferred in Healthcare Administration, Public Health, Psychology, or a related field
* Relevant behavioral health operations experience may substitute for advanced degree

**Core Competencies**

* **Operational precision** — manages complex, multi-site scheduling, documentation audits, and compliance workflows simultaneously without dropping details
* **Clinical operations fluency** — understands the intersection of clinical practice and administrative systems; supports EHR workflows, credentialing timelines, and continuity of care protocols independently
* **Proactive communication** — anticipates downstream impacts (licensure changes, offboarding, site gaps) and initiates coordination before problems surface
* **Data orientation** — tracks productivity metrics, census data, conversion rates, and bonus calculations; translates operational data into actionable recommendations
* **Cross-functional collaboration** — effective working across clinical, administrative, contracting, and leadership teams across multiple locations
* **Judgment under ambiguity** — able to support high-acuity cases and process improvement initiatives with minimal direction

**Benefits**
------------

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Paid time off (vacation, sick leave, and holidays)
* CEU/professional development support
* Collaborative, mission-driven work environment within a CARF-accredited organization

**Compensation & Work Location**
--------------------------------

**Pay:** Starting at $30 per hour, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

**Work Location:** In person — San Jose

*LGTC Group, P.C. is an equal opportunity employer committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.*

new_jobs.description:
**Position Overview :**
  
Our client in San Jose, CA, is seeking a Quality Assurance Consultant for a three-month engagement to support manufacturing compliance initiatives and remediation activities in preparation for an anticipated FDA inspection in early 2027.

The consultant will focus on addressing manufacturing deviations, CAPAs, and quality findings identified through internal facility and manufacturing line audits. Responsibilities may also include reviewing GMP batch records, evaluating documentation for compliance, and supporting efforts to ensure manufacturing operations are inspection-ready as the company advances toward a Biologics License Application (BLA).

The ideal candidate brings experience in pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical manufacturing quality, deviation investigations, CAPA management.  
**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Review and address manufacturing deviations and CAPAs identified through internal audits of the facility and manufacturing operations.
* Support root cause investigations, develop corrective and preventive action plans, and assist with timely resolution of outstanding quality issues.
* Evaluate manufacturing processes and documentation to identify compliance gaps and opportunities for remediation.
* Review GMP batch production records for completeness, accuracy, adherence to procedures, and compliance with applicable quality requirements.
* Support the development, execution, and documentation of corrective actions to strengthen compliance.
* Partner with Quality Assurance, Manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams to resolve quality issues and ensure effective implementation of remediation activities.
* Maintain accurate, complete, and inspection-ready documentation of investigations, CAPAs, and related quality activities.
* Support inspection-readiness initiatives in anticipation of an FDA inspection expected between February and April 2027.
* Contribute to quality and compliance activities supporting the company's progress toward a BLA submission.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Compliance, or Manufacturing Quality within the pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical industry.
* Hands-on experience investigating manufacturing deviations and managing CAPAs in a GMP-regulated environment.
* Experience reviewing batch records and manufacturing documentation.
* Strong investigation, documentation, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize remediation activities, and deliver results within a defined contract period.

new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Bamboo Health is the leader in Real-Time Care Intelligence™ solutions aimed at improving lives for everyone experiencing physical and behavioral health challenges. We are driven by our mission to empower clients to deliver seamless, high-quality and cost-effective care during pivotal moments to improve health outcomes. From coast to coast, Bamboo Health partners with all major retail pharmacy chains, 52 states and territories, 100% of the top 10 best hospitals and more than half of the country’s largest health plans to improve more than 1 billion patient encounters annually. Join us in improving lives during pivotal care moments!

**Summary:**

Bamboo Health is building a team of compassionate clinicians and leaders who are committed to improving care access to those in most need. We are seeking a seasoned, highly motivated Senior Project Manager who can bridge clinical, operational, and technical workstreams across provider and payor organizations. This role owns end-to-end project delivery—from initial scoping through go-live and post-launch stabilization—while consulting directly with customers on workflow design to drive results and accelerate implementation timelines. In addition to leading individual implementations, you will manage a portfolio of partner engagements, balancing competing priorities, risks, and stakeholder needs while helping scale implementation best practices across the organization. The ideal candidate brings a strong mix of project management and client success experience, deep healthcare delivery knowledge, and the judgment to work independently with minimal oversight, comfortably tailoring communication across a variety of stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

**What You’ll Do:**

  

* Own the full implementation lifecycle for new provider or payor partners, working independently and with minimal oversight to ensure all milestones, deliverables, and outcomes are met on time and within scope.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for external partners, including health systems, provider networks, and payors.
* Partner with customers and internal clinical and operational teams to design workflows, staffing models, referral pathways, and escalation processes that support successful implementation and accelerate time to value.
* Collaborate with data integration and IT teams to enable connectivity with EHRs, care management platforms, and analytics tools.
* Guide partners through workflow changes, training, and adoption planning to drive results and ensure smooth go-live transitions.
* Maintain project plans and status reports, as well as risks and issues logs.
* Tailor communication of progress, dependencies, and mitigation plans across audiences, from junior project managers to executive leadership, both internally and externally.
* Capture lessons learned and feedback to refine implementation methodology, mentor less experienced project managers, and accelerate future rollouts.
* Manage a portfolio of concurrent implementations, balancing timelines, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder priorities to ensure successful delivery.
* Identify repetitive tasks and partner with team leads to implement scalable automation solutions.

**What Success Looks Like…**

**In 3 months…**

* Take ownership of at least one active implementation, serving as the primary customer contact while maintaining accurate status reporting, risk management, and stakeholder communication.
* Build strong relationships with key internal and external stakeholders and identify opportunities to improve workflows, processes, or implementation efficiency.
* Identify at least one opportunity in your role to pilot or apply AI or automation (e.g., streamlining a task, summarizing data, generating content).

**In 6 months…**

* Independently manage a portfolio of concurrent implementations, consistently delivering key milestones on time and within scope.
* Lead partners through workflow design, operational readiness, training, adoption planning, and go-live execution.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to customers while mentoring less experienced project managers and contributing implementation best practices across the team.

**In 12 months…**

* Deliver multiple successful go-lives with measurable post-launch stabilization, such as partner adoption targets met and time to value shortened compared with baseline.
* Capture lessons learned across your implementations and contribute at least two lasting improvements to our implementation playbook, templates, or tools.
* Be recognized as a go-to leader for complex implementations, influencing customer outcomes, supporting executive-level partner relationships, and helping elevate implementation excellence across the organization.

**What You Need:**

* Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of combined experience in healthcare project management and account/client success, preferably with exposure to behavioral health, care coordination, or population health in technology enabled services.
* Proven success independently leading complex implementations or partnerships involving provider organizations, payors, or health IT vendors, with minimal oversight.
* Experience with EHR integrations, referral management workflows, or value-based care initiatives strongly preferred.
* A consultative, proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with strong attention to detail.
* Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity, solve complex problems, and independently drive projects forward in dynamic environments.
* Strongly empathetic with a keen desire to reduce barriers to behavioral health and social services for the underserved.
* Ability to convey technical information and tailor communication across a range of audiences and levels, from junior project managers to clinicians, administrators, and C-level executives, exercising strong, independent judgment in what and how to communicate with customers.
* PMP (Project Management Professional, PMI) is preferred.

new_jobs.description:
The Power Sensing and Regulation Product Line Quality Leader develops and deploys the global quality strategy for the Power Sensing and Regulation product line. The role covers quality planning, quality assurance, quality control and the Quality Management System across the full product lifecycle, from tendering and product development to sourcing, manufacturing, project execution and service.
  
The role is reporting to the Product Line Leader, and functionally to the Business Line Quality Leader. The Product Line Quality Leader functionally leads factory quality leaders and collaborates with engineering, operations, sourcing, project and business leaders. The role is accountable for a strong quality culture, high customer satisfaction, prevention of customer escapes and continuous improvement of product and process quality.

**Job Description**
===================

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and deploy the global quality strategy, priorities and governance for the Power Sensing and Regulation product line, in full alignment with Power Transmission’s Quality roadmap.

* Drive the Zero-Defect Framework towards Level 4 through clear action plans, standard work, capability building and regular progress reviews.

* Ensure holistic integration of the factories' Quality Management Systems into Power Transmission's Business Management System. Take an active role in shaping the QMS to support the evolution of the business, in partnership with Power Transmission's central functions.

* Functionally lead and coach the factory quality teams. Set common standards, operating rhythms, measures and expectations across sites, and be accountable for meeting the Product Line Quality KPI targets.

* Be accountable for fulfilling quality engineering requirements during New Product Introduction (NPI) in the Product Line. Cover the full process from Design FMEA and Process FMEA through Control Plans and Reaction Plans, and drive aligned quality-built-in roadmaps across the Product Line.

* Lead complex global customer complaints and root cause analyses. Ensure rapid containment, clear customer communication, verified root cause and sustainable corrective action.

* Apply lessons learned and read across with factories and functions. Ensure relevant learning is built into risk analyses, standards and process controls.

* Drive a strong problem-solving culture using structured methods such as 8D, 5 Why, Ishikawa and fault-tree analysis.

* Use digital tools, data analytics and AI to improve prevention, traceability, risk detection and decision-making.

* Manage and drive the Customer Experience (CX) roadmap for the Product Line. Translate customer feedback and quality performance into clear priorities and improvement actions.

* Monitor and improve customer escapes, cost of poor quality, complaint closure, audit findings and first-pass yield.

* Build strong cross-functional teams with technical experts and business leaders to solve quality issues and deliver improvement plans.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* University degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a comparable technical field.

* At least 10 years of experience in quality, engineering or manufacturing, including leadership of global or multi-site activities.

* Strong technical knowledge of power sensing and regulation products, including design, manufacturing, testing, installation and service risks. Experience with instrument transformers, sensors, voltage regulation equipment, monitoring systems or related control technologies is preferred.

* Strong knowledge of Design FMEA, Process FMEA, APQP, Control Plans, Reaction Plans, MSA, SPC, process capability and ISO 9001.

* Experience with IEC or IEEE standards is a strong advantage.

* Proven experience leading major customer complaints, structured root cause analysis and corrective action programmes.

* Experience with digital quality systems, data analytics, automation or AI applications is an advantage.

* Fluent English.

**Desired Skills and Characteristics**

* Strong functional leadership and the ability to influence across a global matrix organisation.

* Customer-focused, fact-based and decisive during complex quality issues.

* Able to build trust and align technical experts, factory teams and business leaders around common goals.

* Clear communicator with the confidence to engage customers and senior leaders.

* Proactive, disciplined and focused on prevention, learning and sustainable results.

* Comfortable working with multicultural and cross-functional teams.

* Curious about digitalisation and AI, with a practical focus on business and quality outcomes.

* Collaborates openly with peers and functions, shares knowledge and works towards the best outcome for the Product Line and Power Transmission.

* Provides practical support, coaching and clear direction to factories and teams so they can meet their commitments and be successful.

* Demonstrates the GE Vernova Values in decisions, collaboration, customer engagement and daily leadership.
